clear_glass.truth: transparent clear glass with visible wall thickness, rim glints, edge density, internal back-wall separation, and controlled refraction.
prompt_lines: Use clear glass material truth: visible wall thickness, rim highlights, subtle gray/cream edge density, and clean transparent body structure.
Glass may show small caustics and refracted background bends only inside or immediately under the glass.

swirl_glass.truth: transparent clear glass with molded diagonal helical flutes/swirl ribs, visible wall thickness, rim glints, edge density, internal back-wall separation, and controlled refraction.
prompt_lines: Use swirl-fluted clear glass material truth: preserve diagonal helical ribs molded into the clear glass body, with transparent peaks and valleys visible through refraction.
The swirl texture belongs only to the glass body; keep caps, sprayers, collars, tubes, pumps, bulbs, tassels, and detached over-caps smooth and non-swirl.
Glass may show small caustics and refracted background bends only inside or immediately under the glass.
avoid: smooth plain cylinder when swirl is required
swirl texture on caps or sprayers

frosted_glass.truth: translucent frosted glass with soft diffusion, visible wall thickness, satin glow, and gentle edge density.
prompt_lines: Use frosted glass material truth: translucent satin diffusion, thicker edge density, soft rim highlights, and no clear see-through interior.
Keep frost even and premium, not dirty, smoky, or blotchy.

amber_glass.truth: transparent amber glass with warm brown-gold body color, rim density, refraction, and base mass.
prompt_lines: Use amber glass material truth: transparent warm amber body, darker edge density, rim thickness, and subtle base caustics.
Do not turn amber glass into opaque brown plastic.

cobalt_glass.truth: transparent cobalt blue glass with saturated blue edge density, rim glints, and controlled refraction.
prompt_lines: Use cobalt glass material truth: saturated blue transparent body, deeper blue edges, bright rim glints, and clean optical volume.
Do not bleach cobalt to pale blue or make it opaque plastic.

green_glass.truth: transparent green glass with natural green edge density, rim glints, and optical volume.
prompt_lines: Use green glass material truth: transparent green body, darker green edges, controlled refraction, and visible wall thickness.
Do not turn green glass into opaque resin or plastic.

clear_molded_plastic.truth: clear molded plastic with softer transparency, molded edge seams if present, lighter weight, and less optical caustic behavior than glass.
prompt_lines: Use clear molded plastic material truth: lighter-weight transparent plastic, soft molded edges, subtle seam evidence if present, and no heavy glass caustics.
Do not make clear plastic look like crystal, thick luxury glass, or smoky glass.

frosted_plastic.truth: frosted plastic with soft matte diffusion, molded edges, and low-gloss surface response.
prompt_lines: Use frosted plastic material truth: matte translucent plastic, soft molded edges, and restrained non-glass highlights.
Do not add glass rim sparkle, caustics, or thick refraction.

white_plastic.truth: opaque white plastic with visible edge separation, molded curvature, and soft specular highlights.
prompt_lines: Use white plastic material truth: opaque white molded plastic with visible edges, top lips, sidewalls, and subtle gray shadow separation.
White plastic must not disappear into the Bone background.

black_plastic.truth: opaque black plastic with controlled reflection, visible molded shape, and preserved silhouette.
prompt_lines: Use black plastic material truth: opaque molded plastic, controlled soft highlights, clean edge separation, and no chrome reflectivity.
Do not crush black plastic into a featureless silhouette.

polished_gold_metal.truth: polished gold metal with warm specular bands, dark edge cards, and mirror-like but controlled reflection.
prompt_lines: Use polished gold metal truth: warm metallic reflection, dark edge-card separation, clean cylindrical highlights, and no flat yellow plastic.
Gold trim must remain gold, not bronze, black, or white.

polished_silver_metal.truth: polished silver metal with cool specular bands, dark edge cards, and crisp metal highlights.
prompt_lines: Use polished silver metal truth: cool reflective metal, edge-card definition, and clean highlight bands.
Do not turn silver metal into white plastic or gray rubber.

brushed_aluminum.truth: opaque brushed or satin aluminum with fine grain, soft vertical sheen, and no transparency.
prompt_lines: Use brushed aluminum truth: opaque satin metal, fine grain, soft vertical highlight bands, and no glass refraction.
Do not show liquid, back-wall refraction, internal tubes, or transparent edges through aluminum.

rubber_bulb.truth: soft rubber bulb with tactile matte/satin surface, rounded compression form, and accurate color.
prompt_lines: Use rubber bulb truth: soft rounded rubber surface, subtle satin highlight, tactile texture, and accurate bulb color.
Do not make rubber look like metal, glass, or hard plastic.

glass_pipette.truth: thin clear glass pipette with precise tube geometry, rim glints, and subtle internal highlight.
prompt_lines: Use glass pipette truth: thin transparent tube, tiny rim glints, precise straight geometry, and no melting or bending.
Do not thicken the pipette into a straw or plastic tube.

organza_fabric.truth: sheer organza fabric with fine woven texture, translucent folds, drawstring detail, and soft shadowing.
prompt_lines: Use organza fabric truth: sheer woven texture, translucent folds, drawstring detail, and soft fabric shadows.
Do not make organza glossy plastic, paper, glass, or metal.

velvet_fabric.truth: velvet fabric with soft pile, directional nap, rich color, and dimensional folds.
prompt_lines: Use velvet fabric truth: soft pile, directional nap, tactile folds, and rich non-glossy color.
Do not make velvet look like satin plastic, metal, or paper.

folding_carton_paperboard.truth: folding carton paperboard with flat panels, crisp folds, soft paper fiber finish, and no transparency.
prompt_lines: Use folding carton paperboard truth: flat paper panels, crisp scored folds, subtle matte paper texture, and clean edge definition.
Do not use glass-style optical effects, liquid-bending effects, metal grain, fabric weave, or transparency.
